note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; both the alate and the soldier are recorded as unknown in the original, so only the worker section is given; the species was originally described from workers alone; the synonymy list, figure references and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule golden brown; antennae, labrum and legs pale yellow; postclypeus slightly paler than head; tergites and sternites translucent; head and thorax sparsely pilose, abdomen more densely pilose. Total length about 5.0-5.6. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 1.0-1.13, maximum width 1.20-1.27); sides narrowing sharply behind the middle; sutures indistinct; mid-dorsal spot circular and small (diameter 0.13), strongly raised. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 clavate and seemingly subdivided, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus raised, with a few setae, divided by the median line into two halves, about half as long as wide or slightly less than half (length 0.27-0.30, width 0.58-0.60). Labrum dome-shaped (length 0.40-0.43, width 0.47). Right mandible with marginal tooth 2 truncate; remaining mandibular characters as in the genus. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.37-0.40, width 0.66). Tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
